title: Why Josh Downs, Jonathan Taylor should've played their last game for the Colts
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and 107.5 The Fan's Caleb Zuver discuss the uncertain futures of Josh Downs and Jonathan Taylor after the Indianapolis Colts' loss to the Dallas Cowboys. The NFL's trade deadline is Tuesday at 4 p.m. ET. Will both of them be gone? Should they be? Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company.
